disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.intro: Please read the following information before using Kapteins Daagbok.
disclaimer.e2e_body: Your logbook data is encrypted end-to-end. Only you – or people with your key – can read the contents. The server stores encrypted data only.
disclaimer.pwa_body: Kapteins Daagbok runs as a Progressive Web App in your browser and can be installed on your device – similar to a native app, without an app store.
disclaimer.storage_body: Your data is cached locally on your device (IndexedDB). When online, changes are synced to the server. You can keep working offline; sync happens when connectivity returns.
disclaimer.free_body: Kapteins Daagbok is free to use and contains no advertising.
disclaimer.liability_body: Use is at your own risk. No liability is accepted for damages arising from use of the app – including incorrect or incomplete log entries, data loss, or technical failures.
disclaimer.warranty_body: No warranty is provided for functionality, accuracy, or availability of the service. Operation may be interrupted, limited, or discontinued at any time.

welcome.title: Welcome aboard!
welcome.body: We created a demo logbook with three travel days in Kiel Bay. You can delete the sample entries anytime when you're ready to start your own logbook. This short tour shows you the key features.

welcome_public.title: Welcome aboard!
welcome_public.body: Explore our demo logbook with three travel days in Kiel Bay — no account required. The tour covers log entries and vessel and crew selection for this logbook. Manage your fleet and core crew later in your user profile.

nav_logs.title: Log entries
nav_logs.body: Manage your travel days here – departure, destination, weather, tank levels, and GPS tracks.

entry_list.title: Your travel days
entry_list.body: Each card represents one travel day. Tap an entry to view or edit the details.

entry_open.title: Open a travel day
entry_open.body: This is what a filled log entry looks like – with events, tank levels, and more.

entry_track.title: GPS track
entry_track.body: Upload GPX files or view saved routes on the map – including distance and speed stats.

nav_vessel.title: Vessel for logbook
nav_vessel.body: Choose a vessel from your fleet for this logbook. Manage vessels in your user profile under Fleet & crew.

profile_vessel_pool.title: Vessel fleet
profile_vessel_pool.body: In your user profile you add all your vessels — charter yachts, your own boat, etc. Then pick the right vessel per logbook.

profile_crew_pool.title: Core Crew & skippers
profile_crew_pool.body: In your user profile you maintain a person pool — multiple skippers (e.g. charter) and crew for all logbooks.

nav_logbook_crew.title: Crew per logbook
nav_logbook_crew.body: Pick skipper and crew from the pool for this logbook. Travel days inherit this selection by default.

nav_stats.title: Statistics dashboard
nav_stats.body: View travel distances, consumption, route maps, and propulsion breakdown — calculated automatically from your log entries.

nav_feedback.title: Send feedback
nav_feedback.body: Use this form to report bugs, ideas, or general feedback to the project team — you can also open it anytime later via the icon in the top right.

nav_profile.title: Your user profile
nav_profile.body: Tap the skipper button at the top to open your personal profile — independent of the current logbook.

profile_preferences.title: Account & appearance
profile_preferences.body: Manage your account identity, theme, and light/dark mode here. You can restart the app tour anytime. Passkeys and security settings are further down on the profile page.

finish.title: You're all set!
finish.body: You'll land on the statistics dashboard next. You can restart the tour anytime from your user profile. Fair winds!

seo.title: Kapteins Daagbok – Free Digital Yacht Logbook (Ad-Free)
seo.description: Free, ad-free digital yacht logbook with end-to-end encryption and Passkey sign-in. Document travel days, GPS tracks, crew and vessel data securely — offline-capable PWA.
seo.keywords: yacht logbook, ship logbook, sailing log, maritime logbook, passkey, E2E encryption, GPS track, free, ad-free, offline PWA
